in_hebrew.name: אלוד
in_hebrew.meaning: ילדה, ילדה, ילדה, מרחק, נעורים, צעירה, צעיר, אלוד
in_hebrew.long_meaning: אלוד, Alel, Aleud: אל, El, God + לוד, Lud, beauty, youth. name of a female, means young or beautiful. name of a place in the Bible, in the book of Genesis 14:2, 14:8. associated with the French name Élodie, used in early Christian tradition to signify a young or beautiful Christian woman. in Jewish tradition, the name Alel/Aleud signifies a connection to the divine beauty and youth, symbolizing the pursuit of spiritual growth and renewal.

in_greek.name: Ἠλῴη
in_greek.meaning: παιδί, παιδαγωγός, νέος, νέαν, νεανία, νεανίς
in_greek.long_meaning: Ἠλῴη, Elōīē: Ἠ, Ē, God + λω, lō, beautiful. name of a female, means beautiful, young, or lovely. name derived from the Greek word for beautiful and youthful, used in early Christian tradition to signify a young and lovely Christian woman. associated with the French name Élodie, signifying the beauty and innocence of Christian youth. in early Christian tradition, the name Elōīē signifies a connection to the divine beauty and youthful innocence, symbolizing the pursuit of spiritual growth and renewal.

in_latin.name: Elodia
in_latin.meaning: filia Dei, filio Dei, puella Dei, puellae, puellus, juvenis, juvenis, juvenalis
in_latin.long_meaning: Elodia: filia Dei, daughter of God, filio Dei, son of God, puella Dei, girl of God, puellae, young girl, puellus, boy or youth, juvenis, young, juvenis, young, juvenalis, youthful. name used in early Christian tradition to signify a young and lovely Christian daughter of God. associated with the French name Élodie, signifying the beauty and innocence of Christian youth. in early Christian tradition, the name Elodia signifies a connection to the divine beauty and youthful innocence, symbolizing the pursuit of spiritual growth and renewal, emphasizing the importance of Christian youth and their role in the Church.
